name: Spreadsheets (native)
description: Spreadsheets with formulas (IronCalc), in-tree Rust: the native twin of the Python sheets plugin, same tools and grid: .xlsx artifacts, .csv/.tsv tables, an editable grid, and tools to describe, read, write, fill, restructure and format sheets.
prompt: Spreadsheets: for a .csv, .tsv or .xlsx file in the workspace (or a spreadsheet artifact), use the sheet tools with its path or id as `sheet`: describe_sheet to look, write_cells/fill to add columns or formulas (the file is opened as a spreadsheet beside the chat; the original stays as it is). Prefer them over editing such files with code.

artifact_types.label: spreadsheet
artifact_types.pick: tables of numbers, budgets, anything with formulas → a spreadsheet (create_sheet)

tools.name: create_sheet
tools.title: Create spreadsheet
tools.description: Make a new spreadsheet artifact (.xlsx), empty or imported from a workspace .csv/.tsv/.xlsx file (`from`). Then fill it with write_cells, using the id byob reports.

filename.description: File name ending in .xlsx (default: from the title).

from.description: Optional workspace path of a .csv, .tsv or .xlsx file to import.

tools.name: describe_sheet
tools.title: Describe spreadsheet
tools.description: Overview of a spreadsheet: sheets, used range, header row, each column's type, count, min/max/sum or distinct values, sample formulas, first rows and error cells. Use it before reading or writing a big sheet.

sheet.description: Artifact id, or a workspace path of a .xlsx/.csv/.tsv file.

tools.name: read_cells
tools.title: Read cells
tools.description: Read cells as a table: column letters on top, row numbers on the left. Up to 2000 cells per call; the reply says how to get the next page.

sheet.description: Artifact id, or a workspace path of a .xlsx/.csv/.tsv file.

range.description: A1 range like A1:D20, B:B, 2:2 or Sheet2!A1:C5 (default: the used range).

what.description: values (default) or formulas (shows =... where a cell has one).

sheet_name.description: Sheet (tab) name; default the first sheet.

tools.name: write_cells
tools.title: Write cells
tools.description: Write values and formulas, then recalculate. Give `rows` (a 2D list written from `start`) or `cells` ({"B2": "=SUM(B3:B9)", "C1": 5}). Text starting with = is a formula. Returns the new values, every error cell and warnings. For a formula repeated down a column use fill instead.

sheet.description: Artifact id, or a workspace path of a .xlsx/.csv/.tsv file.

start.description: Top-left cell for `rows`, like A1 (default) or Summary!A1.

rows.description: Rows of values from `start`, e.g. [["Item","Cost"],["Rent",1200]]. null skips a cell, "" clears it.

cells.description: Single cells by A1 address, e.g. {"B14": "=SUM(B2:B13)"}.

sheet_name.description: Sheet (tab) name; default the first sheet. A new name makes a new sheet.

tools.name: fill
tools.title: Fill formula
tools.description: Fill a range with one formula, written for the range's first cell; the other cells get it with relative references moved like Excel's fill-down ($ parts stay). E.g. range D2:D13, formula =B2*C2 gives D13 =B13*C13. Use D2:D to fill down to the last used row.

sheet.description: Artifact id, or a workspace path of a .xlsx/.csv/.tsv file.

formula.description: Formula for the first cell of the range, like =B2*C2.

sheet_name.description: Sheet (tab) name; default the first sheet.

tools.name: edit_sheet
tools.title: Edit sheet structure
tools.description: Change structure: add_sheet(name), rename_sheet(name, new_name), delete_sheet(name), insert_rows(at, count), delete_rows(at, count), insert_cols(at letter, count), delete_cols(at letter, count), sort(range, by column letter, descending, header), freeze(rows, cols). Formulas are adjusted.

sheet.description: Artifact id, or a workspace path of a .xlsx/.csv/.tsv file.

name.description: Sheet name for add_sheet, rename_sheet, delete_sheet.

at.description: Row number (rows) or column letter (cols) where to insert or delete.

range.description: sort: the range to sort, like A1:D50 (default the used range).

by.description: sort: column letter to sort by, like C.

header.description: sort: true if the range's first row is a header to keep in place (default: guessed).

rows.description: freeze: rows to keep on top (0 for none).

cols.description: freeze: columns to keep at the left (0 for none).

sheet_name.description: Sheet (tab) for row, column, sort and freeze ops; default the first sheet.

tools.name: format_cells
tools.title: Format cells
tools.description: Format a range: number format ("#,##0.00", "0%", "$#,##0", "yyyy-mm-dd"), bold, fill colour, alignment, column width.

sheet.description: Artifact id, or a workspace path of a .xlsx/.csv/.tsv file.

number_format.description: Excel number format, e.g. #,##0.00 or 0% or yyyy-mm-dd.

width.description: Column width in characters (default about 12), for every column in the range.

sheet_name.description: Sheet (tab) name; default the first sheet.

starters.title: Make a budget
starters.prompt: Build a monthly budget spreadsheet with categories, amounts and a summary by category.
